content:
Although AirPods with cameras are not expected to launch until next year, a Bloomberg report suggests Apple may unveil the AirPods 5 at next month's iPhone event. Details are as follows.

The AirPods 5 will be released in two versions: a standard model and an Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) model.

Bloomberg journalist Mark Gurman said in a lengthy report published earlier tonight that Apple may announce a new Mac mini in the coming days, earlier than the previously expected September event.

Gurman also revealed several other new products in Apple's lineup, including the possible AirPods 5 launch next month. He said the company's next event is expected to be held on September 9, when the first foldable iPhone, the iPhone 18 Pro series, and new Apple Watch models are also set to be unveiled.

The report reads as follows:

Apple is also preparing a series of minor updates for its Apple Watch lineup, including upgraded fitness tracking features and a new ceramic case option for the Series 12 model. The company also plans to launch new AirPods at its September product event. According to people familiar with the matter, the new lineup will include the AirPods 5, as an updated version of Apple's entry-level earbuds. The last model update was in 2024. As for the AirPods version equipped with a camera, it is not expected to arrive until next year.

Interestingly, Gurman subsequently added on the social media platform X that the AirPods 5 are expected to launch in two versions: a standard model and a noise cancellation model:

Although there have been few reports on the AirPods 5 launch timeline, the industry generally expects these earbuds to arrive until 2027. Apple is also reportedly developing two AirPods versions equipped with cameras, which will offer AI features through Visual Intelligence and Siri.

Apple previously accidentally added a demonstration video of AirPods equipped with a camera in the macOS 26.7 candidate release, although the clip did not clearly show any differences in the device's appearance.
